text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After claiming her first win as part of Team
Sirius, Silence Suzuka's
conquest begins...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's at it again! Silence Suzuka's
unstoppable! The rest of the pack
can't
catch up!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Farther, farther, and farther still! With
runaway speed, Silence Suzuka
nabs her
second graded race win in a row!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wheeze! ... I can't keep up with that speed of yours!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But what can I do? My normal pace is too
slow, and there's no way I
can catch up at
the end... Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
One more! One more race! Come on,
Suzuka, Spe! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All right, fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Can't we at least take a
five-minute break?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: She flies down the course right from the start, and then she accelerates at the end too! What an amazing racer, that Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't wait to see what she'll bring
to her next race!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, Suzuka's really made a
name for herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Her winning streak certainly is newsworthy,
but her running style itself
seems to be the
bigger topic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Although her front running isn't like
normal front running. It's
something all her
own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just as people's personalities differ, so too
does the running of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I utilize my stamina to make a move
quickly. I can go from fifth place
to first in
an instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As for Brian, she can maintain her speed
for a long period of time.
She conserves
her strength until the homestretch, when
she lets loose
an explosion of speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And Rice... She uses her innate stamina in
a long spurt to completely
dominate her
opponents.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All of us took time to determine our own
strengths and find a running
strategy that
utilizes them the best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Conversely, Suzuka's running is more of an
ideal than a strategy—one
most of us have
written off as impossible.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Jetting out of the starting gate and then racing down the course unrivaled does sound like a dream.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Jetting out of the starting gate and then racing down the course unrivaled does sound like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and Suzuka's actually making that
dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can only hope that we keep seeing that
running of hers. I love
watching her make
the impossible possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her running doesn't just mesmerize fans,
but racers too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scenery she seeks is dreamed of by all
Umamusume, and they
want to see her
achieve her goal as much as she does.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I hope I'm not intruding.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Did you forget something?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Did you forget something?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No. I was just wondering if my next race
has been decided.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Knowing my next race will give me a goal
to work towards in training,
and um... I'm
sure there are other advantages.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka isn't usually the one to
bring up her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this is another sign of her growth.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we could aim for the Kinko
Sho next.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we could aim for the Kinko
Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The Kinko Sho... I believe that one's 2,000
meters.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I understand if that distance worries
you, considering you run
your races at full
speed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I understand if that distance worries
you, considering you run
your races at full
speed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean medium-distance is
impossible. Personally, I
think you can
handle it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean medium-distance is
impossible. Personally, I
think you can
handle it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you believe in me that strongly, how
could I ever be worried?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm curious to see how far my
running style can take me, and
this could
be my chance to find out.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you've been making good progress
in training already. Trying
new things will
only help you grow more!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you can do well in the Kinko Sho, you
might even be able to take
on the
Takarazuka Kinen or the autumn Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you can do well in the Kinko Sho, you
might even be able to take
on the
Takarazuka Kinen or the autumn Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: G1 races...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Exciting, right? But that means your
training will be that much more
intense.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe... That's fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to explore my current style
as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Something tells me... the scenery from that
path will be the most
beautiful of all.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be right alongside you. I can't wait
to get a view of you
achieving your dream.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be right alongside you. I can't wait
to get a view of you
achieving your dream.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll push myself to the limit. Then... we'll
both see the scenery we
seek.
